paper_metadata.title: A Self-Timed Divider Using a New Fast and Robust Pipeline Scheme
paper_metadata.abstract: This paper investigates the potential of self-timed property of differential cascode voltage switch logic (DCVSL) circuits, and examines architectural techniques for achieving self-timing in DCVSL circuits. As a result, a fast and robust handshake scheme for dynamic asynchronous circuit design is proposed. It is novel and more general than other similar schemes. The proposed self-timed datapath scheme is verified by an 8-bit divider which is implemented using AMS 0.6m CMOS technology, and the chip size is about 1 66 mm 70 mm. 1 The chip testing results show that the divider functions correctly and the latency for 8-bit quotient-digit generation is 17 ns (about 58.8 MHz). Fig. 1. Classical asynchronous pipeline architecture.

sections.title: CONCLUSION
sections.text_preview: This paper presents a design of an 8-bit self-timed pipeline divider with a novel self-timed pipeline architecture. The new architecture use a simple yet fast and robust handshake cell. One can conclude from the results of the self-timed divider design that a latch-free DCVSL-based asynchronous datapath can achieve high performance with low hardware cost. REFERENCES [1] E.
